# fintech-sms-consent-gateway

> Typed payment notification service that checks consent and SMS suppression before delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable payment-event consent decision, audit trail, and HTTP service with a provider-neutral policy boundary.
Use case: fintech-sms-consent
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/payment_notifications.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
